features.description: exercise every contract assertion through its real surface and report per assertion
expectedBehavior: Every contract assertion carries a verdict and at least one evidence artifact

features.description: turn the accepted P0 flows (issue closed via merge transaction; abandon terminal state) into install-e2e flow contracts under `.agents/qa/flows/`, reviewed and merged like any other change.
expectedBehavior: Two flow contract files exist under `.agents/qa/flows/` with the five required headings each
Each flow names the CLI steps and the exit-code/ref-state assertions the acceptance sweep observed
The install-e2e parser accepts them (its own shape check passes)
Nothing else changes — the flows are documentation-of-proof, not code

features.description: Extract merge-gate state machine + finalize transaction construction into their own module, byte-for-byte behavior-preserving, so store.rs/pr_merge.rs stay under the 800-code-line size gate when P0 adds keys/fields/checks.
expectedBehavior: Behavior byte-for-byte identical: cargo test (45/45) green before AND after, no test changed
Lint/cargo gates green: fmt, clippy -D warnings -D too_many_lines, no new size-gate violations
Every file that P0 will touch has room under the 800-code-line gate (report final line counts)
No public API renaming that would ripple into tests that P0 does not own

features.description: `git forge pr create` gains a single `--closes <issue-id>`; the closes relationship is recorded in `pr.created` and shown by `pr show`.
expectedBehavior: `pr create --closes <n>` succeeds and the PR shows the closes relationship
`pr create --closes <n>` with a non-existent issue id exits non-zero, creates no PR, and consumes no sequence id (create is atomic)
`pr create` without `--closes` behaves exactly as before (no closes field in the event/body)
`pr show` output for a PR created before this ticket (no closes) renders exactly as before
Existing suite stays green (no assertion weakened)

features.description: When a PR created with `--closes <n>` merges, the `issue.close` is written in the SAME `update-ref` transaction as base CAS + PR-head CAS + pending-result delete.
expectedBehavior: Merge with `--closes` leaves the linked issue closed on success
Already-closed target: merge still succeeds, no second close event, fold state unchanged (still `open: true`→ no — still closed, i.e. `open: false`; the fold's issue chain length is unchanged)
Failed transaction (test-injected CAS clash with GIT_FORGE_TEST_MERGE_BARRIER or a forced base-move) leaves issue open, no partial event
The empty-body `issue.close` event's actor/ts are resolved through the same single identity resolution as every other write (no second path)
Dogfood oracle gains a merge-closes assertion (green in the ordinary merge path)

features.description: A merge that fails its gate (missing approve, stale base, conflict) must never write a partial `issue.close` — the issue stays open and the PR stays unmerged.
expectedBehavior: Gate red (missing approve) with `--closes` → merge exits non-zero, issue open, no `pr.merge` event
Stale base with `--closes` → merge refuses, issue open, no ref change
Conflict on merge with `--closes` → issue open, temp worktree cleaned (existing invariant)
CAS-exhaustion (via test injection) → issue open
Pre-existing failure-class tests unchanged and green (no weakened assertions)

features.description: `git forge pr abandon <n> --reason <text>` writes a `pr.abandoned` event; the PR becomes terminal, and `pr show` displays abandoned + reason. Merge refuses abandoned PRs.
expectedBehavior: `pr abandon <n> --reason <text>` exits zero; `pr show <n>` shows the reason
`pr merge` on an abandoned PR exits non-zero, names the reason, no ref change (no `pr.merge` event, base untouched)
Already-merged PR: `abandon` exits non-zero, no event appended
Unknown PR id: exit non-zero, no counter consumption
Missing/empty reason: exit non-zero, no event

features.description: `git forge pr review` and `git forge ci run` refuse an abandoned PR, appending no event (no new review, no new ci.check).
expectedBehavior: `pr review --approve` on abandoned: exit non-zero, review chain unchanged (pr show shows no new decision)
`ci run` on abandoned: exit non-zero, no new ci.check (pr show still shows the pending check from create)
Both messages name the abandon reason
Non-abandoned PR: existing review/CI behavior byte-identical

features.description: The abandon terminality is enforced on all boundaries: second abandon refuses without writing; merged PR refuses; refs stay unchanged on every refusal.
expectedBehavior: Second abandon: non-zero exit, chain still one `pr.abandoned`, show displays original reason
Merged-then-abandon: non-zero exit, no event
All mutators (merge/review/ci/abandon) refuse an abandoned PR with the same reason text
gf-dogfood.sh covers the double-abandon and merged-abandon refusals
